name: project_resource
summary: Resource allocations, capacity checking and approved resource requests
description: Plan and control people power across the portfolio. Assign employees to projects as allocations (draft to confirmed to released) with a planned percentage for a period, and evaluate each person's committed capacity across every project they touch so over-allocation is flagged immediately on confirmation and by a daily recompute. A resource request captures demand for capacity and only becomes a confirmed allocation through an independent approval (separation of duties so a raiser cannot approve their own request). HR owns contracts and calendars; this module plans and guards assignment, never payroll.
author: Nexa
